title: the seed census (the seeded line's own residue story — the pisano count, the class-three shadow, the value story of the constants, the page's names)

lesson.statement: my seed period stands under any modulus on the skeleton's own cycle: walk the consecutive pair — the zero-one pair — and it returns, the pure cycle, at exactly the pisano count, the count never smaller and never larger — the integer seed c walks the same count, at the five the twenty, at the eight the twelve, at the twelve the twenty-four; the only shadow is the class three mod five: under a five-touching modulus such as the five or the twenty-five the period holds a fifth of the pisano count, the board of twenty-five pairs at the modulus five splitting twenty, four, one, class three that four — at the five the four of the twenty, at the twenty-five the twenty of the one hundred; the census ran thirty-one seeds by twenty-four moduli, zero violations, the eleven touched boards excepted as the lucas shadow of the twin line which this floor does not build; the parity of my seeded lines, end to end, is the rule's own: my sum line walks even, odd, odd — two odds make an even, an even and an odd make an odd, the rule can do no other — the even seeds, the zero among them, walk odd, even, odd, the odd seeds walk odd, odd, even, each rotation from its own start; and the law of my sums dividing: every n-th term of my sum line is a multiple of the n-th term itself — the term at the third index, the two, divides the term at the sixth, the eight, four times, and the term at the ninth, the thirty-four, seventeen times; the term at the fourth, the three, divides the term at the eighth, the twenty-one, seven times; the term at the fifth, the five, divides the term at the tenth, the fifty-five, eleven times; every quotient an exact whole number where the terms stand on my floor, at the line end eighty-four

the off-line seed stands off my line, the constants my owner names — pi, e, and the golden seed, the golden ratio the page names, its letter phi — never by a digit, and their periodicity is the value story, not the residue story: a seed of two or more never repeats a value, every term the sum of the two before it, both positive, outgrowing its predecessor at every step, the period of the value story declared none; the seed-one line shares its one at the start, one and one, and outgrows after; the shadow twin that begins two and one, the lucas numbers the page names, walks the same story, growing closer to the powers of the golden ratio — two, one, three, four, seven, eleven, eighteen, twenty-nine, forty-seven, seventy-six, the last standing under my ceiling, the next crossing it, each its term the next term of my sum line plus the one before; below my zero the page records the sign: the term at minus n is the term at n with its sign turned when n is even and kept when n is odd, the negative terms standing off the floor my line begins at zero, declared, not filed; and the one divided by my eighty-nine, the ceiling my seeded lines cross at the eleventh step, carries in its decimal shadow the fibonacci sequence the page holds — the one, the one, the two, the three, the five, the eight, the thirteen, the twenty-one, the thirty-four, the fifty-five, reading in order from the hundredths place, the multi-term numbers overlapping their neighbors — the decimal itself standing off my floor, never filed; and my sum line is the fibonacci sequence the page names, the terms from the zero under the rule that the next number is the two before it added up, the recursive formula the page holds, the ratio of any two successive terms approaching the golden ratio, the bigger the pair the closer, at the line end eighty-four

theorems.statement: the seed census of my store is filed of record: the seeded lines' cycle under any modulus stands on the skeleton's own pisano count, the integer seed walking that count with the class three mod five shadow under a five-touching modulus, the period a fifth of the count there and nothing less; the off-line constants — pi, e, the golden seed, the golden ratio the page names, the letter phi — stand off the floor, their periodicity the value story, a seed of two or more never repeating a value, the seed-one line sharing its one at the start, and no residue of them under any modulus; the eleven touched boards, the lucas shadow of the twin line, declared at the floor's own limit and never built; the page's names — the fibonacci sequence, the golden ratio, the letter phi, the lucas numbers — declared, never filed; filed on the line, at the line end eighty-four
